about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Pork Belly Gyro Plates with Lemon Potatoes
recipes.summary: Crisp roast pork belly slices with lemon potatoes, tomato, red onion and garlic yoghurt.
steps: Rub the pork with half the oregano, half the garlic, 2 tablespoons of oil and salt. Dry the skin well and leave uncovered in the fridge for 4 hours.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and roast the pork for 30 minutes, until the skin blisters, then reduce to 160°C (140°C fan) for 1 hour 30 minutes, until tender and 85°C inside.
Toss the potato with the lemon juice, remaining oil and oregano and roast alongside for the last 50 minutes, until golden.
Stir the remaining garlic into the yoghurt, slice the pork and serve with the potatoes, tomato and onion.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 70°C; belly is tender at 85°C. Rest for 15 minutes before slicing.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Baked Prawns with Tomato, Chilli and Feta
recipes.summary: Prawns baked in a tomato and ouzo-free herb sauce under melted feta.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and chilli for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 10 minutes, until thick.
Stir in the prawns, top with feta and bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 8 minutes, until the prawns are pink and opaque and the feta softens.
Scatter with parsley and serve with the bread.
notes: Food safety: prawns are cooked when pink, curled and opaque all the way through.

recipes.title: Greek Baked Giant Beans with Spinach and Eggs
recipes.summary: Giant beans baked in tomato with spinach and eggs, with feta on top.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and oregano.
Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer for 10 minutes, until thick, then stir through the spinach until wilted.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5 minutes, until the whites are set.
Scatter with feta and serve from the pan.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Chicken Souvlaki Pita Wraps with Tzatziki
recipes.summary: Lemon-oregano chicken skewers in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato and onion.
steps: Mix the oil, lemon juice, garlic and oregano, add the chicken and marinate for 1 hour.
Thread onto skewers and grill for 12 minutes, turning, until charred and the centre reaches 75°C.
Warm the pita for 1 minute each side, until soft.
Fill with chicken, tzatziki, tomato and onion.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the centre; discard the raw marinade.

recipes.title: Spiced Beef Keftedes with Rice and Tomato
recipes.summary: Herby Greek beef meatballs baked and served on rice with a fresh tomato salad.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Mix the mince, onion, herbs, garlic, oregano, breadcrumbs, egg and salt and roll into 20 balls.
Bake on an oiled tray for 20 minutes, until browned and 75°C in the centre.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Serve the keftedes over the rice with the diced tomato and pan juices.
notes: Food safety: meatballs must reach 75°C right through.

recipes.title: Greek Yoghurt Omelette Wraps with Herbs
recipes.summary: Thin herby omelettes rolled around yoghurt, cucumber and olives.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the dill, mint and a pinch of salt.
Cook half the egg in half the oil in a non-stick pan for 2 minutes, until just set, and repeat.
Spread each omelette with yoghurt and top with cucumber and olives.
Roll up the omelettes, cut each in half and serve warm straight away.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Vegetable Moussaka-Style Stacks
recipes.summary: Layered eggplant, potato and zucchini stacks baked in tomato sauce with a cheesy topping.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the eggplant, potato and zucchini with the oil and roast for 25 minutes, until golden.
Cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes, add the tomatoes and cinnamon and simmer for 15 minutes, until thick.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, whisk in the milk and simmer for 6 minutes, until thick. Stir in half the cheese.
Layer the vegetables and sauce in a dish, top with the white sauce and remaining cheese and bake for 30 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Spanish Chicken and Chorizo Rice Bake
recipes.summary: Rice baked with chicken, chorizo, smoked paprika and peas.
steps: Brown the chicken and chorizo in the oil in an ovenproof pan for 8 minutes, until golden, and lift out. Cook the onion, capsicum and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the paprika and rice, stir for 1 minute, then pour in the hot stock and return the meat.
Bake at 190°C (170°C fan) for 25 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 75°C.
Scatter the peas over, rest for 5 minutes until hot and serve with lemon.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part; refrigerate leftover rice within 1 hour.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Pork and Beef Meatballs in Smoky Almond Sauce
recipes.summary: Soft meatballs simmered in a smoky tomato and almond sauce.
steps: Mix the minces, egg, breadcrumbs, 1 garlic clove, parsley and salt and roll into 20 balls.
Brown the meatballs in half the oil for 8 minutes, until golden, and lift out.
Cook the onion in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic, paprika, tomatoes, almond meal and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Return the meatballs and simmer for 10 minutes, until cooked through at 75°C and the sauce is thick.
notes: Food safety: meatballs must reach 75°C right through.

recipes.title: Garlic Prawn and Chorizo Eggs
recipes.summary: Eggs baked in a sizzling pan of garlic prawns and chorizo.
steps: Fry the chorizo in the oil for 3 minutes, until crisp. Add the garlic and chilli for 30 seconds.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes, until pink and opaque.
Make four gaps, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 4 minutes, until the whites are set.
Scatter with parsley and serve with the bread.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Prawns are cooked when pink and opaque.

recipes.title: Roast Pork Loin with Sherry and Smoked Paprika
recipes.summary: Pork loin rubbed with paprika, roasted over potatoes and sherry.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Rub the pork with the paprika, garlic, half the oil and salt.
Toss the potato and onion with the remaining oil in a roasting dish, set the pork on top and pour in the sherry and stock.
Roast for 20 minutes, reduce to 180°C (160°C fan) and roast for 45 minutes, until the pork reaches 70°C and the potato is golden.
Rest the pork for 10 minutes, slice and scatter with parsley.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C in the centre, then rest.
Gluten-free.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Baked Hake with Pimenton Potatoes and Peppers
recipes.summary: Fish baked over smoky potatoes and roasted peppers with garlic and parsley.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the potato, capsicum, oil, paprika and garlic in a roasting dish and roast for 22 minutes, until nearly tender.
Nestle the fish into the vegetables and spoon over the lemon juice.
Roast for 12 minutes, until the fish turns opaque and flakes easily.
Scatter the parsley over the fish and potatoes and serve straight from the dish.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and flakes with a fork.
Gluten-free.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Spanish Mushroom and Egg Breakfast Toast
recipes.summary: Garlicky mushrooms and fried eggs on toasted bread with smoked paprika.
steps: Cook the mushrooms in half the oil for 8 minutes, until golden and dry. Add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Toast the bread until golden.
Spoon the mushrooms onto the bread and top with the eggs and parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Seafood Fideua
recipes.summary: Short noodles cooked in saffron stock with prawns, mussels and squid, Valencian-style.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil in a wide pan for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and tomato and cook for 8 minutes, until thick and jammy.
Stir in the pasta and saffron for 2 minutes, then add the hot stock and simmer for 8 minutes, until nearly tender.
Nestle in the calamari, prawns and mussels, cover and cook for 6 minutes, until the prawns are pink, the calamari opaque and the mussel shells open. Discard any that stay closed.
Rest for 3 minutes and serve with aioli.
notes: Food safety: seafood is cooked when prawns are pink and opaque and mussel shells have opened; discard any that stay shut.

recipes.title: Lamb and Rosemary Pies
recipes.summary: Individual golden pies of tender lamb, rosemary and red wine.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil for 8 minutes, until golden. Add the onion, carrot and garlic for 6 minutes, stir through the flour, then add the wine, stock and rosemary.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour 30 minutes, until the lamb is tender and the sauce is thick. Cool.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Line six pie tins with pastry, fill, top with pastry and seal. Brush with beaten egg.
Bake for 30 minutes, until golden and the filling reaches 75°C.
notes: Food safety: the filling must be steaming hot (75°C) in the centre.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak with Mushroom Sauce and Chips
recipes.summary: A pan-seared sirloin with creamy mushroom pepper sauce and oven chips.
steps: Bake the chips on a tray at 220°C (200°C fan) for 30 minutes, until golden and crisp.
Press the pepper into the steaks and sear in the oil for 3 minutes each side for medium-rare, until the centre reaches 55°C. Rest for 5 minutes.
Cook the mushrooms and garlic in the butter in the same pan for 6 minutes, until golden. Add the brandy, cream and stock and simmer for 5 minutes, until thickened.
Serve the steaks with the sauce and chips.
notes: Food safety: whole steaks are safe seared; 55°C is medium-rare, 63°C medium, 71°C well done.

recipes.title: Chilli Prawn and Zucchini Pasta
recipes.summary: Garlicky chilli prawns tossed through linguine with zucchini, lemon and parsley.
steps: Cook the linguine in salted boiling water for 10 minutes, until al dente, and drain, keeping 1/2 cup of the water.
Cook the zucchini in the oil for 4 minutes, until golden, then add the garlic and chilli for 1 minute.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes, until pink and opaque.
Toss the pasta through with the lemon, butter, parsley and a splash of pasta water.
notes: Food safety: prawns are cooked when pink, curled and opaque all the way through.

recipes.title: Smashed Pea and Haloumi Breakfast Stack
recipes.summary: Golden halloumi on smashed minty peas with a poached egg and lemon.
steps: Simmer the peas for 3 minutes, until bright and tender, drain and smash with the mint, oil, lemon zest and juice.
Fry the halloumi in a dry pan for 2 minutes each side, until golden.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Toast the sourdough until golden, then stack with the peas, halloumi and eggs.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Honey Soy Barramundi with Ginger Rice
recipes.summary: Barramundi fillets glazed with honey and soy over ginger-scented rice with greens.
steps: Mix the honey, soy sauce, ginger and garlic.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Sear the fish in the oil for 3 minutes per side, add the glaze and cook for 2 minutes, until sticky and the fish is opaque and flakes.
Steam the bok choy for 3 minutes, until tender, and serve with the rice, fish and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and flakes with a fork.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Sweetcorn Fritter Stacks with Crisp Bacon
recipes.summary: Sweet corn fritters with crisp bacon, smashed avocado and lime.
steps: Mix the corn, flour, eggs, milk, spring onion and coriander with a pinch of salt into a thick batter.
Fry spoonfuls in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through.
Cook the bacon in a pan for 6 minutes, until crisp.
Mash the avocado with the lime juice and serve over the fritters with the bacon.
notes: Food safety: fritters are done when golden and set through; bacon should be cooked and crisp.

recipes.title: Pan-Fried Chicken in Marsala Mushroom Sauce
recipes.summary: Pan-fried chicken in a rich Marsala and mushroom sauce.
steps: Slice the chicken breasts in half horizontally and coat in flour. Fry in the oil for 4 minutes per side, until golden, and lift out.
Cook the mushrooms in the same pan for 6 minutes, until golden, then add the garlic.
Add the marsala and stock and simmer for 5 minutes, until reduced by half. Stir in the butter.
Return the chicken for 3 minutes until it reaches 75°C and serve with the sauce, parsley and potato.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part.

recipes.title: Slow-Roasted Tomato and Basil Risotto
recipes.summary: Creamy risotto with slow-roasted tomatoes, basil and mascarpone.
steps: Roast the tomatoes with 2 tablespoons of oil at 180°C (160°C fan) for 30 minutes, until collapsed and sticky.
Cook the onion in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic and rice and stir for 2 minutes, then the wine until absorbed.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring for 20 minutes, until the rice is creamy and tender.
Stir in the mascarpone, cheese and basil until creamy and top with the roast tomatoes.
notes: Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Baked Gnocchi alla Sorrentina
recipes.summary: Potato gnocchi baked in tomato sauce under melting mozzarella and basil.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cook the garlic in the oil for 1 minute, add the passata and simmer for 8 minutes, until thick.
Stir in the gnocchi and half the basil and tip into a baking dish.
Top with mozzarella and cheese and bake for 20 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
Scatter with the remaining basil.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Pork Fillet Saltimbocca with Sage Potatoes
recipes.summary: Pork fillet wrapped in prosciutto and sage, pan-fried and served with crisp potatoes.
steps: Roast the potato in 1 tablespoon of oil at 220°C (200°C fan) for 30 minutes, until crisp.
Cut the pork into eight pieces, flatten, top each with sage and wrap in prosciutto.
Fry in the remaining oil for 4 minutes per side, until golden and the centre reaches 70°C. Lift out and rest.
Add the wine to the pan and simmer for 3 minutes, whisk in the butter and spoon over the pork.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C in the centre with no pink.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Italian Breakfast Frittata with Spinach and Ricotta
recipes.summary: A thick baked frittata with spinach, ricotta and sundried tomatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Wilt the spinach and spring onion in the oil in an ovenproof pan for 3 minutes, until soft.
Whisk the eggs with the cheese and seasoning and pour over, dotting with ricotta and tomato.
Cook on the stove for 3 minutes, until the edges set.
Bake for 15 minutes, until puffed and set in the centre.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Tuscan Beef Stew with Rosemary and Red Wine
recipes.summary: Beef braised in red wine, tomato and rosemary until tender, served over polenta.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil in batches for 10 minutes, until deep golden, and lift out. Cook the onion and carrot for 6 minutes, add the garlic and wine and boil for 3 minutes.
Return the beef with the tomatoes, rosemary and stock, cover and simmer for 2 hours 30 minutes, until very tender.
Bring the water to the boil, whisk in the polenta and cook for 25 minutes, until thick, then stir in the butter.
Serve the beef over the polenta.
notes: Food safety: beef chuck is safe at 75°C and tender once it falls apart; the stew should be steaming hot.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Coq au Riesling-Style Chicken with Bacon and Onions
recipes.summary: Chicken braised in white wine with bacon, mushrooms and baby onions.
steps: Fry the bacon in a heavy pot until crisp for 5 minutes and lift out. Brown the chicken in the fat for 8 minutes, until golden, and lift out.
Cook the onions and mushrooms in the butter for 8 minutes, until golden, then add the garlic and wine and boil for 3 minutes.
Return the chicken and bacon with the stock and thyme, cover and simmer for 35 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C.
Stir in the cream, simmer for 5 minutes until slightly thick and serve with the potato.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Mussels in White Wine and Garlic with Frites
recipes.summary: Mussels steamed in white wine, garlic and herbs, with crisp frites.
steps: Bake the chips at 220°C (200°C fan) for 30 minutes, until golden and crisp.
Cook the shallot in the butter in a large pot for 4 minutes, then add the garlic and wine and bring to the boil.
Add the mussels, cover and cook for 5 minutes, shaking the pot, until the shells have opened. Discard any that stay closed.
Stir in the cream and parsley and serve with the frites.
notes: Food safety: mussel shells must open when cooked; discard any that stay closed.

recipes.title: Pork Normande with Apples and Mustard
recipes.summary: Pork steaks with caramelised apple and a cream mustard sauce.
steps: Season the pork and sear in the oil for 5 minutes each side, until golden and the centre reaches 70°C. Lift out and rest.
Cook the apple in the butter for 4 minutes, until golden. Add the shallot and thyme for 2 minutes.
Add the apple juice and boil for 3 minutes, then the cream and mustard and simmer for 3 minutes, until slightly thick.
Return the pork for 1 minute and serve with the potato.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C in the centre, then rest.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: French Omelette with Herbs and Goat Cheese
recipes.summary: A soft rolled omelette with chives, tarragon and creamy goat cheese.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the herbs and a pinch of salt.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan until foaming and pour in the eggs.
Stir gently for 1 minute, then leave to set for 1 minute, until the base is just cooked and the top is still soft.
Add the goat cheese, roll onto a plate and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Lamb Navarin with Spring Vegetables
recipes.summary: A light French lamb stew with young carrots, peas and baby potatoes.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil in a heavy pot for 8 minutes, until golden. Add the onion and garlic for 5 minutes, stir through the paste and flour, then the wine and stock.
Add the thyme, cover and simmer for 1 hour, until the lamb is nearly tender.
Add the potatoes and carrots and cook for 30 minutes, until tender.
Stir through the peas for 3 minutes until hot.
notes: Food safety: lamb is safe at 63°C; this braise cooks well beyond that and should be steaming hot.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Egg Cocotte with Chives
recipes.summary: Eggs baked in cream with smoked salmon and chives in small ramekins.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Butter two ramekins and divide the salmon and cream between them.
Crack in the eggs and season.
Bake in a tray of hot water for 12 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks soft.
Scatter with chives and serve with toasted baguette.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Smoked salmon is not recommended during pregnancy.

recipes.title: Chicken and Leek Mash-Topped Pie
recipes.summary: A crusty mashed-potato topped pie of chicken and leek in a creamy sauce.
steps: Cook the leek in the butter for 6 minutes, add the chicken and cook for 8 minutes, until cooked through.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, add the stock, cream and mustard and simmer for 6 minutes, until thick.
Tip into a dish and cover with mash mixed with the egg yolk, ruffling the top.
Bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 25 minutes, until golden and the filling is steaming and reaches 75°C.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C throughout and the pie be steaming hot.

recipes.title: Smoky Black Bean Tostada Stack
recipes.summary: Crisp corn tortillas layered with smoky beans, cheese, slaw and avocado.
steps: Brush the tortillas with oil and bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 8 minutes, until crisp.
Warm the beans with the chipotle and garlic and mash roughly for 5 minutes, until thick.
Spread the beans on the tostadas, top with cheese and grill for 2 minutes, until melted.
Top with slaw, avocado and coriander.
notes: Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Moroccan Chicken Meatballs in Tomato with Eggs
recipes.summary: Spiced chicken meatballs poached in tomato sauce with eggs.
steps: Mix the mince, cumin, paprika, 1 garlic clove, parsley and salt and roll into 16 balls.
Brown the meatballs in half the oil for 6 minutes, until golden, and lift out. Cook the onion in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic, tomatoes and harissa and simmer for 8 minutes.
Return the meatballs and simmer for 8 minutes, until cooked through at 75°C.
Crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 4 minutes, until the whites are set.
notes: Food safety: chicken mince must reach 75°C right through; cook the eggs until the whites are set.
Gluten-free.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Jerk Chicken Rice Bowls with Pineapple Slaw
recipes.summary: Jerk-spiced chicken over rice and beans with a crunchy pineapple slaw.
steps: Mix the oil, allspice, thyme, chilli, garlic and soy sauce and coat the chicken. Marinate for 1 hour.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, adding the beans for the last 2 minutes. Drain.
Cook the chicken in a hot pan for 12 minutes, turning, until charred and 75°C inside. Rest and slice.
Toss the pineapple, slaw and lime juice and serve over the rice with the chicken.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Hungarian Paprika Potatoes with Fried Eggs
recipes.summary: Paprika potatoes with onion and sausage under fried eggs.
steps: Fry the sausage and onion in the oil for 8 minutes, until golden. Add the paprika, capsicum and potato with 1/2 cup water.
Cover and cook for 20 minutes, until the potato is tender and the water has gone.
Fry the eggs for 3 minutes in a separate pan, until the whites are set.
Serve the potatoes topped with the eggs and parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Pulled Beef Brisket Sliders
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked shredded brisket with tangy slaw in soft rolls.
steps: Mix the paprika, sugar, garlic powder and salt and rub over the brisket. Rest for 1 hour.
Place in a deep tray with the stock, cover tightly and cook at 150°C (130°C fan) for 4 hours 30 minutes, until the centre reaches 93°C and shreds easily.
Shred the beef in the juices and stir through the bbq sauce.
Pile into the buns with the slaw.
notes: Food safety: brisket needs to reach 93°C to shred (it is safe at 63°C); the filling should be steaming hot.
